whatIs: Illos is a library of 186 animated SVG illustrations in five styles: Shader, HUD, Isometric, Interface and Cybernetics, each in a light and a dark version. Each illustration is a single SVG file with the animation included, no scripts or web fonts, and it respects the reduced motion preference.
It's a good fit when you want illustrations with a consistent style for a product site, or want your coding agent to draw new ones in the same style.
uses: Illustrating a landing page's sections with SVGs that weigh just a few KB.
Adding an illustration to a React project with shadcn using an install command.
Asking your coding agent for new illustrations in the same style using the skills.
caveats: 79 illustrations are free; the rest and the skills require the Pro plan.
You can't resell the illustrations as a package or use them to build a competing library.
Purchases are final, except for a double charge or a license that never arrives.
pricingNote: 79 illustrations are free without an account; Pro costs $69 and Team $299, both as one-time payments.
idealFor: Product sites that want lightweight, consistent animated illustrations.
